newsitem.title: USA: Uniflex Inc buys back shares at discount.
newsitem.headline: Uniflex Inc buys back shares at discount.

text.p: Uniflex Inc said Wednesday it purchased, at a discount, 379,904 shares of its common stock from a founding shareholder and a current manager. The company added that this one time opportunity to buy-back shares would be beneficial to its earnings.
In a statement the company said it bought the shares plus the options to purchase shares from the founding shareholder at a 17 percent discount from current market prices.

Uniflex president and chief operating officer, Robert Semel, said, "The personal financial needs of these two individuals required that they sell a large number of shares of common stock and the company was able to negotiate the repurchase of such shares at a substantial discount to recent prices."
Uniflex is a maker of specialty bags used for packaging, promotions and advertising.
The company's stock is currently down 3/16 at 6-11/16 in mid-afternoon trading.
